description: Sorted key-value map backed by std/container/bounded_array.mm. Focus on Z3-verifiable bookkeeping atoms for insertion position, length update, and pair ordering witnesses that preserve the sorted-key invariant after insert. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/container/sorted_map — verified sorted key-value map'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm and std/container/bounded_array.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm and bounded_array.mm already use.

atoms.name: sorted_map_insert_position
atoms.description: Return a caller-proven insertion position within [0, len] for a sorted map with len entries.

atoms.name: sorted_map_insert_len
atoms.description: Length update after inserting a new key-value pair into bounded storage.

atoms.name: sorted_map_key_ordered
atoms.description: Boolean witness that adjacent keys are ordered non-decreasingly.
